verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Zapier integration on its pricing page and pushes notes into work tools like ClickUp, Airtable, Google Drive, Jira and Asana, so notes do reach tools where work happens. The Zapier support is only a pricing-line mention, and the evidence never names Slack or Notion. missing for 10: Slack channel posting, Notion page sync, detailed Zapier trigger/action documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
Otter automatically sends transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata to Airtable.
sending actions items from meetings into tools they already use, like JIRA, Asana, and others.
